title_internal: The translation trap (you do this every conversation)

rewatch_engineering.loop_trick: Stopwatch reads 00:00 in first frame and final frame; hard cut wraps invisibly
rewatch_engineering.hidden_detail: A digital clock in the background increments in milliseconds throughout, counting from 000 to 002000. Only readable on a paused watch #2. Tells the viewer the lag is happening in real time.
rewatch_engineering.punchline_reveal: Opens 'You do this every conversation' (accusation). Closes 'Until you stop' (agency). Same words, opposite emotional weight
rewatch_engineering.info_density: Three layers of math (300ms x N sentences = 2 min lag) plus 3 fix names in 30s. Viewers loop to extract the routine
rewatch_engineering.visual_rhythm: Ticks on every '300ms' beat. Three kick drums on the 3 fix names

beats.visual: Tight macro of a stopwatch reading 00:00. Single sharp tick. Background blur shows a digital ms counter at 000 (hidden detail starts here)
beats.caption: YOU DO THIS

beats.visual: Animated brain receiving sound waves; a delay bar fills 300ms in the middle of the brain
beats.caption: 300ms | LAG
beats.audio: low pulse on each ms increment
beats.voice_line: When someone speaks English to you, your brain takes three hundred milliseconds to translate.

beats.visual: Calculator widget on screen, 300 typed in
beats.caption: INVISIBLE | until math
beats.voice_line: That's invisible. Until you do the math.

beats.caption: 300ms x 400 = | 2 MIN LAG
beats.voice_line: Three hundred milliseconds times every sentence in a five-minute chat equals two minutes of lag.

beats.visual: Two figures in conversation; one's thought bubble shows '...slow' / '...stupid'
beats.caption: They think SLOW. | You think STUPID.
beats.voice_line: Two minutes where natives think you're slow. You think you're stupid.

beats.visual: Both thought bubbles burst. Big text fills frame: 'NEITHER.'
beats.caption: NEITHER. | You're TRANSLATING.

beats.visual: Stopwatch resets and counts up to 03:00. Calendar shows 14 days flipping
beats.caption: 3 MIN/DAY | 14 DAYS
beats.voice_line: Three-minute daily drill kills it in fourteen days.

beats.visual: Three icons appear on the beat: eye / hand / brain with image
beats.caption: OBJECT | VERB | IMAGE
beats.voice_line: Object naming. Verb mapping. Image replacement.

beats.visual: Cut back to opening stopwatch at 00:00 (loop). Text: 'Until you stop.'
beats.caption: Until you stop.
beats.voice_line: You do this every conversation. Until you stop.
